user.title: Add a pet device
user.description: Name your pet and pick its world. The egg decides which of that world's creatures hatches.

abort.no_worlds: No pet worlds are ready yet. Reinstall the integration files and try again.

no_pet.message: No virtual pet matches that config entry.

fast_forward.name: Fast forward
fast_forward.description: Debug tool: lives through the given number of hours right now, at normal rates. Calls left unanswered in that time count as care misses.

config_entry_id.name: Pet
config_entry_id.description: Which pet. Leave empty for all pets.

init.title: What the pet notices
init.description: Map parts of your home to the pet. Everything is optional: unmapped things are simply ignored. The house never hurts the pet; it only changes its mood, its scene and what it asks for.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: The pet gets drowsy near bedtime and falls asleep when lights-out is on, or when the bedtime lights are off and the house is quiet. Home signals never wake it.

data_description.bedtime_lights: When all of these are off at bedtime (and no motion for 10 minutes), the pet goes to bed. Bedroom lights work well.
data_description.motion: Indoor sensors only. Recent motion keeps the house from counting as quiet.

weather.name: Weather and air
weather.description: A local weather station beats a forecast: a rain sensor decides rainy days, and a solar radiation sensor decides sunny ones. The weather entity fills in the rest (snow, fog).

data_description.rain: A rain rate (any value above 0 means raining) or an on/off "it's raining" entity.
data_description.solar: Watts per square metre. 300 or more counts as sunny.
data_description.indoor_temperature: Too cold or warm makes the pet ask for a blanket or a fan. It never makes it sick.

room.name: The pet's room
room.description: Bright light late at night makes the pet squint; dim evening light makes it cozy. Daylight is never too bright.

data_description.fireplace: Any entity that's on (or heating, or above 0) when the fire is lit. The pet curls up by it, and it never asks for a blanket next to a lit fire.

activity.name: People and activity
activity.description: Someone arriving gets an excited greeting. After 2 hours with nobody home the pet goes to the sitter's and time stops for it.

data_description.privacy: On: dashboards never show that the house is empty (the pet just looks asleep) and the pet never names anyone.
